native

First-party Tiinex native artifacts and qualified building blocks consumed by Core and hosts. Current carried authority is centered on the first-party Scaffold catalog plus the bounded schema-authority/companion extraction frontier; do not infer that Native currently owns Entry or Process catalogs merely because it may host first-party content in the future.

Grounding boundary:
- Docs owns semantic contracts.
- Core owns host-neutral mechanics and projections.
- Native owns maintained first-party qualified content.
- Start from `.topics/.workspaces/tiinex-native.workspace.md`, the Native structural-boundary Decision, current Reduction material, and the explicit `.topics/work/001-native-schema-authority-and-companion-extraction-task.trace.md` only when that Project frontier is intentionally resumed.
- Do not move Core mechanics or Docs authority into Native merely to centralize files.
- Inside `.topics`, dot-prefixed roots are reserved registered Tiinex structural/authority namespaces; do not invent them ad hoc. Canonical Tiinex artifacts belong under `.topics`; executable implementation normally belongs under `src`.

Current Scaffold catalog:
- `tiinex.native.workspace-base.v1` — canonical minimal universal Workspace base.
- `tiinex.native.workspace-work.v1` — additive `.topics/work` capability.
- `tiinex.native.workspace-process.v1` — additive process-root capability for a consuming Workspace; this does not mean Native itself currently carries a Process catalog.
- `tiinex.native.workspace-reduction.v1` — additive reduction-root capability.
- `tiinex.native.workspace-schema-authority.v1` — schema-authority roots.
- `tiinex.native.workspace-organization.v1` — organization roots.
- `tiinex.native.repository-software-package.v1` — shared software-repository roots.

Select base/capabilities explicitly. Catalog presence is not applicability, Parent ancestry is not catalog order or structural inheritance, and legacy subject roots are not moved without a qualified migration plan.
